SUMMARY: The architectural design for BI-PF-1550 strictly adheres to enterprise requirements, employing Go for secure core cryptographic operations (AES-256-GCM with HKDF-SHA256) and Python for build-time tooling in compliance with the language rule.
All acceptance criteria (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3) are thoroughly mapped to explicit control primitives, automated test verification vectors, and fail-closed operational invariants.
Top risks regarding key derivation mismatches and raw prompt asset leakage are adequately mitigated via shared HKDF specifications and automated release packaging scanners.
